tier_legend.Production-Ready: Working code + real data or self-contained client-grade demo today.
tier_legend.Sample-Only: Code path works but shipped data is sample/seed/live-on-demand, or a known import/CLI blocker exists.
tier_legend.Roadmap: Stub, empty data catalog with no wired source, or off-manifest/unindexed. Not a GTM asset today.

capabilities.evidence: worldenergydata.fdas.api.EconomicsQuery; reports/gtm/2026-05-04-fdas-field-development-economics.html (63 KB, 4 scenarios)
capabilities.note: Self-contained economics engine with a client-grade interactive report today. No external data required.
